hooks.command: jq '(.tool_input.url // "") as $url | ($url | ltrimstr("https://") | ltrimstr("http://") | split("/")[0] | ltrimstr("www.")) as $host | if ($host == "x.com" or $host == "twitter.com" or $host == "linkedin.com") then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"WebFetch cannot see login-walled content (x.com/twitter.com/linkedin.com). Main agent: use a logged-in browser tool (the one the user-level CLAUDE.md names, else mcp__claude-in-chrome__*); subagents: report could-not-fetch. Browser ops count as writes -- acquire runs/.lock first, release after, never two browser tasks in parallel. Full rule: AGENT-GUIDE.md section \"Login-walled content\"."}} else empty end'

jq '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("(^|[;&|] *|npx +)(vercel|wrangler)( +[^;&|]*)? +(deploy|--prod)|(^|[;&|] *)npm +publish")) and (($c | test("(^|[;&|] *)cd +[^;&|]+[;&]")) | not) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Deploy/publish commands must never run from the knowledge-base directory (it would publish the whole KB as a site). cd into the target repo with an absolute path in the same command."}} else empty end'
